starter:
-- Orders per day over the Black Friday weekend (Fri 28 Nov to Mon 1 Dec 2025)
SELECT
  date(order_date) AS day,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-28' AND '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
solution:
SELECT
  date(order_date) AS day,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2025-11-28'
  AND order_date < '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
